name: t3-workflow
description: T3 Code-native branch coordination, Red/Blue adversarial TDD, and task wrap-up cleanup skills (t3-branch-coordinator, t3-tdd-adversarial, t3-task-cleanup). Works seamlessly with t3-tri-plan and t3-cr-loop for end-to-end release-branch orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Branch coordinator, contract-first Red/Blue adversarial TDD, and fail-closed task cleanup for T3 Code.
interface.longDescription: T3 Code-native orchestration suite containing three composable skills: t3-branch-coordinator (bootstrap/bind target branch, interview requirements, run dual-model UI mockups, and launch governed top-level task sessions via t3_thread_launch), t3-tdd-adversarial (contract-first Red/Blue parallel worktree TDD with audited net-patch allowlist gates, per-ID red-to-green verification, and pre-push SHA/PR-coverage gates), and t3-task-cleanup (fail-closed, identity-bound post-merge cleanup of task temp files, child worktrees, and atomic CAS temp-branch deletion).
defaultPrompt: Use t3-branch-coordinator to manage this release branch.
Run t3-tdd-adversarial on the current activated task.
Run t3-task-cleanup to wrap up this completed task.
